description: Create a new UML model element (MODEL ONLY — not placed on any diagram canvas). For native typed diagrams (Use Case, Activity, Class), use create_element_with_view instead so shapes appear in the diagram. The 'type' is a metamodel class name. Requires staruml-mcp-extension to be installed in StarUML. Install from https://github.com/ezrabrilliant/staruml-mcp-extension
name: create_element
